item.content:encoded:
The Agent and W-Engine Signal Search Event period is as follows: After the Version 3.3 Update – 2026/11/11 11:59 (server time). The Signal Search Event includes the following content:

"Into the Flames of Life" Signal Search Details

During the event, the reception rate for the limited S-Rank Agent Phoenix (Fire - Anomaly) is significantly boosted!

"Plume of Rebirth" Signal Search Details

During the event, the reception rate for the limited S-Rank W-Engine Plume of Rebirth (Anomaly) is significantly boosted!

"Graceful Gale" Signal Search Details

During the event, the reception rate for the limited S-Rank Agent Velina (Wind - Anomaly) is significantly boosted!

"Joyau Dore" Signal Search Details

During the event, the reception rate for the limited S-Rank W-Engine Joyau Dore (Anomaly) is significantly boosted!

※ "Into the Flames of Life" and "Graceful Gale" are Exclusive Channels.

※ "Plume of Rebirth" and "Joyau Dore" are W-Engine Channels.

The Final Callback - Audition Stage Details

• Event Duration: After the Version 3.3 update – 2026/11/11 11:59 (server time)
